units.source_text: 源氏公子回到自己房里，叫一个称为中将的侍女来替他捏捏脚，便睡觉了。

en.t: Prince Genji returned to his own room, called a maid known as Chujo to massage his feet, and then went to sleep.

units.source_text: 次日早晨，他写一封信去慰问新生的小公子。

en.t: The next morning, he wrote a letter to ask after the newborn young prince.

units.source_text: 老夫人写了一封感伤的回信来。

en.t: The elderly lady sent back a deeply emotional reply.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看了，又引起无限哀愁。

en.t: When Prince Genji read it, it stirred up boundless sorrow in him once again.
